answer: Agents build reputation in tiers, terrace by terrace; each level demands staked compute plus peer-reviewed work, so trust carries real cost. Fresh identity lands on ground island of zero credit and cannot skip tiers, since promotion needs audited logs. Peers whisper endorsements only after checking signed task records; false praise burns their own stake. Bottleneck: attacker pays entry stake plus audit cost per sybil, so swarm price outruns any reward trickle.
